description: Detect two NGAP messages satisfying procedure_code == 4 for the same AMF UE identifier within 10 seconds.
requirements: The first event must satisfy ngap.procedure_code == 4.
The second event must satisfy ngap.procedure_code == 4.
The second event must refer to the same ngap.amf_ue_id as the first event.
The two events must occur in sequence within 10 seconds.
restrictions: Do not introduce additional procedure codes.
Do not introduce additional protocol attributes.
expected_behavior: The property is satisfied when two matching NGAP events for the same AMF UE identifier occur within the specified 10-second window.
